name: Labeled Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) and Chest X-Ray Images for Classification
description: Dataset of validated OCT and Chest X-Ray images  described and analyzed in "Deep learning-based classification and referral of treatable human diseases". The OCT Images are split into a training set and a testing set of independent patients. OCT Images are labeled as (disease)-(randomized patient ID)-(image number by this patient) and split into 4 directories: CNV, DME, DRUSEN, and NORMAL.
